blocks.text: TAMPAKAN, South Cotabato – To save the local hog industry, the local government here regulated the farmgate floor price for live pigs alongside launching a meat-and-rice incentive that benefits both vendors and consumers. Mayor Leonard Escobillo issued Executive Order (EO) No. 40, Series of 2026, establishing regulatory floor prices for live pigs amid concerns raised by backyard hog raisers about predatory low buying prices and hefty production costs. In addition, consumers who buy from the Tampakan Community Meat Shop and other accredited local vendors get one kilogram (kg) of rice for every kilo of meat purchased as part of the stopgap […]...
